title: Median score
statementMd:
Compute the median score of all graded enrollments (average the two middle values if the count is even).

Expected columns: `median_score`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Number the sorted scores and pick the middle row(s).
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH r AS (SELECT score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY score) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM enrollments WHERE score IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(score) AS median_score FROM r WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
